title: Greenfield Protocol, Database & Realtime Optimization Pass
description: Structured longitudinal performance snapshots capturing schema, wire, API DB, client SQLite, query plan, multi-party scenario, and scaling probe metrics across greenfield optimization PRs.

entries.label: Main baseline (53819b364)
entries.notes: Epoch 2 baseline at 53819b364 before greenfield optimization PRs. All runtime probes ran on clean 53819b364; static perf:inventory ran with the Epoch 2 false-positive filter applied (dirty: true reflects only that performance harness edit).

entries.label: Server update counts & parent-lane batch (#3342)
entries.notes: Trigger-maintained documents.update_count + attribution_revision/updated_at; roster-profile container suppression; verified idsOnly root-membership parent-lane batch inside repeatable-read snapshot.

entries.label: Subtree-root realtime interest & hub caps (#3353)
entries.notes: Declares only subtree roots (top-level roots + directly granted nested folders persisted via root_lane_member v18 migration) with hub subtree-coverage routing, 256-root declaration/installed cap, 512 pending id cap, flat 10s deadline, repeatable-read 1,024 path-container depth budget scoped via discoveryGrantSubjects/containerHasDiscoveryAccess, and marker write-back. 100x1000-folder simultaneous reconnect contention: 318-323ms total, p99 hint lag 1.7-2.6ms, 18-21 MiB peak heap.

entries.label: Preserved peer ownership, owner allow-restore, pull-only park, multi-segment recovery, causal closure (#3263)
entries.notes: Adds purged_document_peer_owners table (58th Postgres table, +2 indexes) via append-only migration 0018 (+7 bootstrap DDL statements per fresh PGlite canary; 0 extra hot-path runtime queries or plan regressions).

entries.label: PR #7 (#3396 Leads 1 & 4): API tx memo and PG plans
entries.notes: Eliminated API pure read repeats inside transactions/lock holds (principal policy evidence reuse, container manifest/org memoization, prelocked provisioning scope, verified pre-lock sync access reuse under held frontier locks) and eliminated Postgres generic-plan Sort/Materialize.

entries.label: PR #8 (#3396 Lead 2): wire compactness, authored KEK citations, held history & read-path policy warmers
entries.notes: Normalizes containerManifestHistory out of KEK level citation digests, caches authored container KEK levels on mutation acknowledgement, verifies locally held principal policy chains before GET /principals/history, and enables preferLocalCurrent on read/verification/read-only-pull policy warmers (keeping write-planning warmers fresh).
